title: Creamy Porcini Soup
description: A rich and comforting Italian-inspired soup made with porcini mushrooms, velvety cream, and a hint of nutty flavor.

ingredients.name: nutty broth
ingredients.notes: use vegetable broth as a substitute if needed

instructions: Heat the porcini broth in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the kalguksu noodles and cook according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, sauté the porcini mushrooms in a little bit of oil until tender.
Add the sautéed mushrooms to the saucepan with the noodles and broth.
Stir in the velvety cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
